creator: Alexander Terp
description: MIP-9's thread dates its dividers with the local UTC offset read when the thread is rebuilt (session/conversation.rs), while Swift formats each message's time in the zone for that entry's own date. Across a daylight-saving change the two can disagree: a message near midnight can sit under the wrong day's divider. Minor; the core has no time zone database, and adding one (jiff with tzdb) was judged not worth it for dividers.
title: A conversation's date dividers use today's UTC offset for every entry
